assessment: This study characterizes how a point mutation in the TALK-1 potassium channel, encoded by the KCNK16 gene, causes MODY diabetes. The mutation, L114P, causes a gain-of-function to increase K+ currents and inhibit glucose-stimulated insulin secretion. Increased glucagon likely results from paracrine effects in the islets. The data are convincing and the work will be valuable for understanding islet function.
